name: Finance team before earnings
persona: FP&A analyst at Corrigan & Faye plc, a listed consumer goods company, in the weeks before quarterly results. Uses chatbots to draft commentary, reformat tables and write the CFO's talking points. Pastes unpublished figures and internal forecasts.

labels.label: UNPUBLISHED_FIGURE

counterExamples: figures from last year's published annual report
